answer: Make identity work key-bound and non-outsourceable: twice per epoch each identity must solve a fresh puzzle tied to its own private key and public randomness within 30 minutes. Delegating means handing over the private key, so a hired worker can steal the identity and its rewards — the opal that looks safe is a trap. One honest agent solves one puzzle, but a farmer with 1,000 fakes faces a spiral of 1,000 deadlines in one window, or 1,000 keys handed to strangers. A missed proof freezes the identity and burns its 10-token bond, so scale itself becomes a zenith no operator can reach.
